note: The spec is normative. Where a vector and spec/ disagree, the spec wins and the vector is wrong (spec/11-conformance.md section 7).
invariant: An adjacency record is u16le degree, then one zigzag uvar per neighbour: the first is the slot id itself (a delta from 0), each later one the signed delta from the previous slot id. F-197: Java once wrote the first as a plain uvar; a reader of the other encoding halves or doubles it.
